title: Spending the $1.6 billion federal recovery grant
summary: As of late September 2026, the county is spending a $1.6 billion HUD disaster recovery grant, with $1.39 billion obligated and spending projected through 2031. Staff report 577 housing units completed, 400 under construction and 597 in progress, with 83 shopping letters issued in the first-time homebuyer program. Rising infrastructure costs are a key risk, and multifamily rebuilds must give fire survivors priority to move back.

timeline.text: The County's Hoʻokumu Hou First-Time Homebuyer program issued its 100th shopping letter to displaced fire survivors.

source.publisher: County of Maui Office of Recovery
source.quote: Eighteen households displaced by the 2023 Maui Wildfires received their home-shopping letters today through the County of Maui’s Hoʻokumu Hou First-Time Homebuyer Opportunity Program, bringing the total issued through the program to 100.

timeline.text: A speaker said the federal government gave 1.6 billion dollars for housing and rebuilding.
timeline.body: County Council Special Meeting

timeline.text: The chair deferred the disaster recovery item.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff said the funding for multifamily rebuilds requires them to give fire survivors priority to move back.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff said 577 housing units are completed, 400 are under construction and 597 are in progress.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff said 83 shopping letters have been issued in the first-time homebuyer program.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff named rising infrastructure costs as a key risk.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff said it is a six-year grant with spending projected through 2031.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff said the county deals directly with the federal government on these funds, with no state in the middle.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff said $1.39 billion of the $1.6 billion has been obligated, meaning set aside for programs.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff said the funds are geared primarily toward helping housing.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The county is spending $1.6 billion in disaster recovery block grant funds from HUD.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The county has committed $1.278 billion of its $1.6 billion in recovery funds.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The managing director said heavy subsidies are needed to bring these projects back for people who already lived there.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: About $96 million has been conditionally awarded for rebuilding the French Street Apartments.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Officials said much of the rebuild funding is going to 11 multifamily housing rebuilds.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The chair said the administration will give the Council reports on the grant.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Rule 7B overview of federal disaster recovery grant funding: The committee deferred the overview item on federal disaster recovery grant funding.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The administrator said data and community feedback show housing is the biggest need.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The draft action plan sets aside $903 million for housing, starting in Lahaina.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: HUD will tell the County yes or no on the action plan within 45 days.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff said they are looking at deed restriction programs tied to the funding to help keep properties with families.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Staff said housing projects not funded by the Affordable Housing Fund can apply for this grant.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The administrator said HUD gives the County six years to spend the grant.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The County's request for proposals for an implementation contractor closes in about two weeks.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Program policies and eligibility intake will be developed after the action plan, aiming for this summer.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: HUD requires 15% of the grant to go to mitigation (work to reduce future disaster risk).
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: Planned programs include single-family home rebuilding and multi-family rental rebuilding.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: The administrator said this grant is the funding of last resort that fills the gap left by insurance, nonprofits and other federal programs.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
